about: Brief 123 P5: a 20 x 10 m single-storey box at Chicago O'Hare with a gable cold loft (L1, L2), a warm mono-pitch (M1, M2) and a flat roof (F0, F0c). Read by validation/energyplus/123_roof_referee.py (EnergyPlus) and frontend/src/thermal/engine/__tests__/loftBox.ts (the engine), so both are built from these inputs. Committed before the first run. Layers outside first ([thickness m, conductivity W/mK, specific heat J/kgK, density kg/m3]; density 0 = no-mass, R = thickness/conductivity). The ceiling's layers run loft side first. Walls, floor and window are the Brief 104 cooled room's (104_cooled_room_spec.json).

gable.ridge: along x (east-west): slopes face south and north, triangular gable walls east and west

convection: iso_conv: outside 20 W/m2K on every exterior face; inside by tilt as the engine's REFEREE_OPTIONS (walls, gable walls and windows 2.5; faces whose heat flows upward from the zone, tilt < 60: 5.0; downward, tilt > 120: 0.7). Engine at 4 steps an hour, EnergyPlus Timestep 4, EulerMethod.

gates.note: Brief 123 P5 table. A miss is reported as a miss, never tuned. Room-level cooling gaps of Briefs 103-108 are reported beside each case's own effect.
